name: פישוט ביטוי – ((v − 1/v)² + 2) ÷ (1/v²) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Simplify the following: \[\left( \left({{CT:0}}-\frac{1}{{CT:0}} \right)^{2}+2\right)\div{\frac{1}{{CT:1}}}.\]
Give an equivalent expression without brackets.
= [[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
When required to peform combinations of multiplication or division the best trick is to focus on one operation at a time. In this example:
\[ \left(\left({{CT:0}}-\frac{1}{{CT:0}}\right)^{2}+2\right)\div{\frac{1}{{CT:1}}} = {\left({{CT:0}}^{2}+\frac{1}{{{CT:0}}^{2}}-2\right)}\div{\frac{1}{{CT:1}}} = {\left({{CT:0}}^{2}+\frac{1}{{{CT:0}}^{2}}-2\right)}\cdot{{CT:1}} = {{CT:2}}. \]

on_true.feedback: Your answer is algebraically equivalent to the correct answer but is not in it's simplest form.
